text:
Please contact poison control, your doctor, or emergency services right now about your toddler, before anything else. I can't advise on the health side, so follow their guidance. If it helps, tell them it was a peace lily.

Once your child is looked after, a smashed pot counts as damaged on arrival. Report it within **48 hours** of delivery with photos of the plant and the box. You can then choose a free replacement on the next plant shipping day, or a refund. Since this plant has already been chewed, you may want to keep it well out of your toddler's reach or ask about disposal.
